aarti.tek: Victory, victory to Mother Gāyatrī; victory, victory to Mother Gāyatrī.
aarti.pad1: You are the primal Power, unseen and stainless, the sustainer of the world; you take away sorrow, grief, fear, affliction, strife, poverty and wretchedness. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: O Mother whose form is Brahman, who protects those who bow to you and upholds the world; O Mother of the world, who takes away the fear of worldly existence, does good to people and gives happiness. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Remover of fear, who carries us across worldly existence, O sinless one, unborn, a treasury of bliss: you are changeless, the remover of sin, unshaken, pure and imperishable. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: You are the wish-fulfilling cow, being, consciousness and bliss; victory to you, Gaṅgā, Gītā. You are the eternal power of Savitṛ, the Sun, Sāvitrī and Sītā. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Beloved of the Ṛg, Yajur, Sāma and Atharva Vedas, Praṇava (Om), O you of great glory. You are Kuṇḍalinī, Sahasrāra, Suṣumnā and splendour, O you who are great in virtue. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You are Svāhā, Svadhā, Śacī, Brahmāṇī, Rādhā and Rudrāṇī; victory to you, Śatarūpā, Vāṇī, Vidyā, Kamalā, Kalyāṇī. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Mother, we are lowly and helpless, hemmed in by sorrow and poverty. Though we are crooked, deceitful and unworthy sons, still we are your children. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: Mother, steeped in love and full of compassion, give us refuge at your feet. We, your little children, are weeping: look on us with mercy. ॥8॥
aarti.pad9: Take away desire, anger, pride, greed, hypocrisy, ill will and hatred. Make our understanding pure, our heart sinless and our mind holy. ॥9॥
aarti.pad10: You are able in every way, the one who carries us across, the protector who gives contentment and nourishment. Lead us on the path of truth, which gives happiness. ॥10॥
